# Test fixture — fake résumé

Not a real person. Written to exercise the job-search Fit path, which stays empty until a résumé is
on file. Matches the dev profile's criteria (Senior/Staff Product Designer, small product-led
companies). Paste the block below into the Job Search chat and approve the `resume.set` write.

---

**Alex Rendell**
Product Designer · Bristol, UK · alex.rendell@example.com · alexrendell.example.com

## Summary

Product designer with 9 years across consumer and B2B software, most of it as the first or second
designer at companies between 15 and 120 people. I do the whole arc — problem framing, research,
interaction, visual, and the front-end work needed to get it shipped honestly. I care most about
design having real weight in what gets built, and I have spent enough time in heavy enterprise
process to know I do not want to go back to it.

## Experience

**Senior Product Designer — Marlowe (Series B, 90 people) · 2022–present**
Second designer on a scheduling product for independent clinics. Owned the booking and availability
surfaces end to end. Rebuilt the availability editor after research showed practice managers were
maintaining a parallel paper rota; the rewrite cut setup time from ~40 minutes to under 6 and
removed the top support-ticket category entirely. Built and maintain the design system (78
components, Figma + a Storybook I write the CSS for). Run a fortnightly research session with real
clinic staff and publish the notes internally.

**Product Designer — Kettle (Series A, 30 people) · 2019–2022**
First design hire. Set up the research practice, the design system, and the weekly critique.
Designed the onboarding flow that took activation from 31% to 54% over two quarters. Shipped the
mobile app's first release with one engineer. Left when the company was acquired.

**Product Designer — Northbank Digital (agency) · 2017–2019**
Client work across fintech and public sector. Good training in shipping fast against a brief; the
reason I moved in-house was wanting to see what happens after launch.

## Skills

Figma (advanced, including variables and component APIs), interaction and motion design, design
systems, qualitative research and usability testing, prototyping in code (HTML/CSS, React,
TypeScript to a working-prototype level), accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA, writing UI copy.

## What I want next

A senior or staff role at a product-led company small enough that design sits in the room where
product decisions get made. Comfortable being the most senior designer and setting the practice.
Prefer remote or hybrid; open to occasional travel. Not looking for a large enterprise org with a
long approval chain between design and shipping.

## Education

BA Graphic Communication, University of Reading, 2016.
